title: RESIDE OTS scene-stratified role and haze-budget design
rationale: The authorized OTS exclusion union leaves 8,006 source-independent outdoor clear scenes, but using all 280,210 associated hazy images would be unnecessarily expensive. This route freezes scene roles before model work: 4,000 training scenes, 500 model-development validation scenes, 1,000 measurement-definition scenes, 1,000 measurement-validation scenes, and 1,506 reserve scenes. Allocation uses only clear-image content and paired-depth descriptors, never model outcomes. Training and model-development roles use five fixed haze-parameter grid points per scene; both measurement roles retain access to all 35 variants so later measurement validity is not constrained by this compute reduction. Passing authorizes only an outdoor measurement-definition route and reusable data-role manifests, not model selection or training.

scientific_contract.question: Can the complete authorized 8,006-scene OTS pool be deterministically partitioned into computationally bounded, mutually exclusive development roles while every role preserves frozen content/depth coverage and the official haze-parameter grid remains complete?

intervention.reference: the full 8,006-scene OTS pool authorized by the targeted-geometry PASS and its exact 964-ID exclusion asset
intervention.matched_budget: all 8,006 eligible clear/depth pairs and filename metadata for all 313,950 official OTS hazy files; no model outcome or SOTS/NH-HAZE outcome
fixed_factors: role counts: training 4,000; model-development validation 500; measurement definition 1,000; measurement validation 1,000; reserve 1,506

scene descriptors: clear luminance mean and standard deviation, clear gradient energy and colorfulness, log-depth mean and standard deviation, log-depth interdecile range, and normalized depth-gradient energy
four equal-frequency marginal bins for clear luminance mean, clear gradient energy, log-depth mean, and log-depth interdecile range
deterministic SHA-256 ordering within joint strata and weighted-deficit allocation over a round-robin stratum traversal
coverage gates compare every role with the full eligible pool using all eight descriptors
training and model-development validation use five fixed parameter-grid points: four corners plus the center of the official 5 by 7 grid
measurement-definition and measurement-validation roles retain all 35 haze variants per scene
reserve scenes remain unused unless a later preregistered precision or failure rule explicitly releases them

primary_estimand.metric: maximum two-sample empirical CDF gap between any frozen role and the complete eligible pool across the eight frozen scene descriptors
primary_estimand.aggregation: maximum over five roles and eight descriptors

controls: exact parent PASS terminal and exact 964-ID authorized exclusion asset
full official counts of 8,970 clear files, 8,970 depth files, and 313,950 hazy files
every eligible scene has one clear image, one readable numeric two-dimensional depth field, and the same 35-member haze suffix grid
role lists are exactly disjoint and their union equals all 8,006 eligible scene IDs
synthetic full-scale protected-data-free allocator must terminate within the frozen bound and reproduce exact quotas
a coverage FAIL means only this frozen allocation method failed, not that no adequate OTS subset exists

uncertainty.method: deterministic full-population allocation audit; no patch, pixel, haze variant, or depth location is treated as an independent scene

gates.estimand: parent state, decision, authorization, exclusion count, and exclusion digest match
official OTS clear, depth, and haze counts and eligible scene pairing are complete
proportion of 8,006 eligible depth MAT files containing a finite numeric two-dimensional field
proportion of eligible scenes having the identical official 35-member, two-parameter, 5 by 7 haze grid
all five exact frozen role counts match
role lists are pairwise disjoint and their union is the full eligible pool
largest absolute role versus pool mean difference divided by the pool standard deviation
minimum within-role fraction in any frozen marginal quartile of the four allocation descriptors
minimum within-role fraction below the pool tenth percentile or above the pool ninetieth percentile for any of eight descriptors
fixed five-variant recipe exists and yields 20,000 training plus 2,500 development-validation hazy pairs

scientific_contract.competing_explanation: Apparent balance by file number or random image sampling could hide scene duplication, depth/content holes, or an underpowered model-development split. The full-census feature and grid audit distinguishes those failures before any training. Passing does not validate the later local-degradation construct.
disabled_actions: model or module selection, training, inference, or dehazing outcome evaluation
using SOTS, Haze4K, or NH-HAZE outcomes to choose the split
treating haze variants, pixels, patches, or depth locations as independent scenes
calling the filename parameter-grid order a validated local haze or restoration-demand label
releasing reserve scenes without a later preregistered trigger
using measurement-validation scenes to select a proxy, threshold, or measurement definition
adapting role counts, descriptors, margins, or the five-variant recipe after results

precision_contract.rationale: The smallest role contains 500 independent source scenes, exceeding the worst-case Bernoulli requirement of 385 for a 0.05 two-sided planning half-width at 95 percent confidence. This is capacity evidence only, not power for a future model effect.

capability.production_path_statement: The CPU contract executes the exact 8,006-item quantile-binning, stratum round-robin, weighted-deficit allocation, disjointness, and coverage calculations on synthetic descriptors without reading scientific data.

precision.source_reference: The frozen smallest role contains 500 independent OTS clear source scenes; nested haze variants are excluded from this count.
